items: 4 chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
2 Tbsp flour mixed with a little milk
In a pan over medium heat, sauté chicken in butter until done.
Then add the next 4 ingredients (mushrooms, garlic, sun-dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper) and cook for 3 minutes.
Add cream and chicken broth and simmer 5 more minutes.
Add green onions, Parmesan, and flour mixture. Cook until thickened and simmer for a few more minutes.
Cooked, crumbled bacon is very good added to it too!
